summary: Matador Resources Company (NYSE: MTDR) disclosed via Form 8-K that wholly-owned subsidiaries entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire all membership interests of Paloma Permian, LLC, which holds proved undeveloped acreage and producing oil & gas properties in Eddy and Lea Counties, New Mexico. The purchase price is $1.275 billion in cash (unadjusted), with $63.75 million escrowed. Closing is expected early Q4 2026, effective June 1, 2026, subject to customary conditions including working capital adjustments and title/environmental defects. A representation and warranty insurance policy has been obtained. This bolt-on acquisition expands Matador's Permian Basin position. Watch for regulatory clearance and any pre-closing adjustments affecting the final price.
